english.title: Owner/master of ship fail to ensure compliance with requirement to have a voyage data recorder fitted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[master]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with paragraphs 1 and 2 of regulation 20 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 relating to voyage data recorders in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(j) and 9(1)(d) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
